verdict.rationale: Sierra's own docs describe pre-release 'Simulations' and 'Agent Checks' that catch problems proactively, and scenario-based verification to avoid regressions, so the simulated-conversation half of the story is a first-party capability. Testing against historical tickets is not evidenced, and details of how simulations are authored and run are thin. missing for 10: replay or testing against historical tickets, detailed documentation of how simulated conversations are built and run, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I test the agent against historical tickets or simulated conversations before it faces real customers

citations.quote: Agent Checks and Simulations catching problems proactively
Verify your agent performs as expected across a wide range of scenarios and avoid regressions.
